rationale: A TSB is a fixed structure. Every declared field is present in a valid value, recursively; an invalid child occupies its field as nil. Deltas remain sparse.
REF conveys designation, not a value signal. Repeating an equal reference causes no additional tick or sampling; the first publication, including empty, still ticks.
Whole fixed collection invalidation resets all descendants and the collection to invalid, unmodified, time never, value nil and delta nil. Notification is not a publication.
Changing whole A to A.left plus B.right preserves the unchanged left binding. Only right is sampled and the parent delta contains right only.
A newly selected invalid target and its invalid descendants read unmodified with time never and no sampled delta. Previous binding times cannot leak into the new view.

While the assembled structure stays valid, retain the C++ child-change time and modification observation, including invalidation; idle reads retain that time. When the whole structure becomes invalid, reset its cached observation state and descendants to never/unmodified.
